descriptions.w3d_logic_type_get_800c2654: Returns the global type record of a logic class.
descriptions.w3d_logic_unlink_800c2660: Removes an entity from its logic class instance list and decrements the instance count.
descriptions.w3d_logic_create_800c26a4: Allocates and constructs an entity of a logic class, then registers it in the class instance list.
descriptions.w3d_logic_release_800c2704: Drops one reference to a logic entity; at zero it unlinks the entity and runs its deleting destructor.
descriptions.w3d_logic_retain_800c2760: Adds one reference to a logic entity and returns the previous count.
descriptions.w3d_logic_construct_800c2778: Constructor of a timed weapon-style entity: runs the actor base constructor and clears its held objects, buffer and state.
descriptions.w3d_logic_destroy_800c2810: Destructor of the timed entity: deletes its owned object, frees its buffer, releases nine held objects and runs the base destructor.
descriptions.w3d_logic_hook_800c31f0: Empty hook of a logic class that does nothing.
descriptions.w3d_logic_lookup_800c31f4: Looks up a named resource and stores it in the entity's first held slot.
descriptions.w3d_logic_resource_800c3224: Resolves a value from the entity's second held object through two lookups.
descriptions.w3d_logic_play_800c3250: Plays the configured sound at a position and, if an effect name is set, restarts the entity's effect there.
descriptions.w3d_logic_ready_800c3cf4: Appears to report whether the entity may act: true when the current target is gone or the resource reports ready.
descriptions.w3d_logic_type_get_800c3f54: Returns the global type record of a logic class.
descriptions.w3d_logic_unlink_800c3f60: Removes an entity from its logic class instance list and decrements the instance count.
descriptions.w3d_logic_create_800c3fa4: Allocates and constructs an entity of a logic class, then registers it in the class instance list.
descriptions.w3d_logic_release_800c4004: Drops one reference to a logic entity; at zero it unlinks the entity and runs its deleting destructor.
descriptions.w3d_logic_retain_800c4060: Adds one reference to a logic entity and returns the previous count.
descriptions.w3d_logic_construct_800c4078: Constructor: runs the base constructor, installs the class vtable, clears a held slot and sets a default float.
descriptions.w3d_logic_destroy_800c40c8: Destructor: installs the class vtable, releases held objects and runs the base destructor.
descriptions.w3d_logic_handle_800c4128: Message handler: attach runs the base handler then a setup hook, detach runs a hook; other messages go to the base handler.
descriptions.w3d_logic_hook_800c43a8: Attach hook that copies front-end sky and water settings into level settings and registers two helper classes.
descriptions.w3d_logic_hook_800c44b0: Empty hook of a logic class that does nothing.
